name: ARABICA PEABERRY COFFEE
description:
ANIMAL PRINTED PACKS AVAILABLE IN 500 g ONLY 
  Indian coffees are home to the best shade grown coffees in the world. It grows Arabica and Robusta coffees in the southern states where lush coffee plantations are heavily inter cropped with black pepper and ginger that bustle with honeybees and yield the finest coffee beans.  
  Peaberry coffees are rare, comprising only 3-7% of the total crop. These pea-shaped, natural formations of the coffee bean are thought to form when several pistils get knocked off the coffee flower, causing only one seed to form inside the coffee fruit rather than two.  
  Normally coffee beans grow two to a cherry, flat against each other but in about five percent of the worlds coffee a bean is found to be solo that's Peaberry.  
  Because there's no way to tell from looking at the cherry whether there's a single or double bean inside, as a result Peaberry beans are hand picked and processed to be enjoyed separately.  
 Tasting notes:    
  At Devans, Arabica Peaberry is roasted in a way to create a mild strength of coffee, that is soft, smooth, highly aromatic and flavorful . If you like milder coffees, go for this lighter bodied and a clean cup of coffee. It’s ideal when made in a French Press or a pour over.

   Baba Budangiri, is home to the finest coffee plantations of India. Indian Arabica Peaberry is a hand-selected, pulped, and fully washed coffee. Separating the peaberries from the rest of the coffee beans requires the use of special screens and adds time and effort to the grading process. The resulting peaberry coffee is very dense and uniform, resulting in a very focused and consistent flavor.   
  Expertly roasted in small batches for optimal taste and quality. Arabica Peaberry is given a longer roast for a strong brew. After roasting, the beans appear quite oily. This coffee is perfect for those who are looking to have that "coffee-kick" without the need to have an espresso.

 The second flush Assam CTC is regarded as the best CTC tea in the world.    
  CTC means the tea has been processed in a " Cut, Tear, and Curl" machine. Tea leaves are shoved in the top, totally destroyed and then reformed into pellets. These pellets turn brown (oxidize ) very quickly. This makes for the super-brisk tea.

name: BLACK HONEY COFFEE

The Black Honey process is a drying process where part of the cherry remains on the bean and is covered while drying. The term ‚Äòhoney‚Äô relates to the ‚Äòmucilage‚Äô (sticky substance) left on the coffee bean. Traditional fully-washed coffees have the skin and pulp removed by mechanical washing, but during the honey process the producer will use a hand-roller which gives them full control of the level of mucilage left on the beans.

description:

  Darjeeling First Flush tea especially roasted for DEVANS from Giddapahar tea estate.

  Giddapahar tea garden is located on the Kurseong valley in Darjeeling. The tea bushes grow at an elevation from 4500 to 5200 feet from the sea level. This tea estate is known for its exquisite and characteristic Darjeeling teas grown from century old China bushes. Especially roasted for Devan’s - this is the First Pick of the year 2025.  
   Directly sourced from the Tea Garden in Darjeeling. Small lot, unique, especially roasted for Devans. 
  First Flush is defined as the very first picking of a tea plant’s harvest season. The new leaves plucked during First Flush are the youngest and most tender part of the tea plant and are said to yield the purest and freshest cup of tea. Each additional Flush produces a different flavour and aroma as the growing season for that tea plant progresses.  
  This first flush is of a superior grade and has undergone minimal oxidation which ensures the natural sweetness, freshness and flavours are retained, while giving the tea a mellow and smooth cup. There is a hint of floral fruitiness that reveals itself, with subtle notes of citrus around the edges. The lingering sweetness towards the end stays with you for quite some time.

  Djimmah is grown in the Illubabor and Kaffa regions of Ethiopia at elevations from 4,400 to 6,000 feet above sea level within the biggest catchment area in Ethiopia, an area that produces and exports about 60,000 tons of coffee each year. Djimmah is also called Jimma Coffee. A unique coffee thought to be the variety closest in flavour to the original wild plant. This is an ideal climate and the plants are well protected by the larger forest trees which provide shade from the midday sun and preserve the moisture in the soil.   
  Coffee from Ethiopia is known for its bright fruited and floral flavours. These coffees typically have a higher acidity, light to medium body and complex flavour notes.

A strong Single origin leaf tea from the blue mountains - Nilgiri Tea   
  The Nilgiri Mountains form the border between the southern states of Tamil Nadu, Kerala and Karnataka, but are predominately within the District of Nilgiris, Tamil Nadu. Also called the blue mountain tea, this Nilgiri black tea is stronger in the cup than Darjeeling and Assam.    Nilgiri tea is variously described as being light but full-bodied or well-rounded in flavour, with fruit, like citrus, and floral notes.  
  Single origin leaf tea when brewed, is dark colour in the cup, intensely aromatic, with lively fragrant flavours, a quality attributed to its climatic growing conditions.

description:

The coffee plantation situated at a height of 1300 metres has a shade canopy, comprising evergreen non deciduous trees. name: ROOIBOS TEA
description:
Rooibos tea is made from the leaves of "red bush" plant, which grows only in the small Cederberg region of South Africa. Because it does not derive from the Camillia sinensis plant (like black, white, green or oolong teas), rooibos tea is considered more of an herbal drink or tisane than a "true" tea. Rooibos tea is often called "red tea" or "red bush" tea because of the bright red coloring the leaves take on during the oxidation and fermentation processes. A properly brewed cup of rooibos tea will be a rich red color and have a sweet, nutty flavour.   
 Net weight: 50 g
